question: According to the Planning Commission of India (2011-12), which state has the highest percentage of the population below the poverty line?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chhattisgarh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• According to the Planning Commission of India (2011-12), **Chhattisgarh** had the highest percentage of the population below the poverty line.

• The poverty rate in Chhattisgarh was reported to be **39.93%**.

• Rural poverty in Chhattisgarh was significantly high, contributing to the overall percentage.

• Chhattisgarh's economy heavily relies on agriculture and forestry, which can be vulnerable to seasonal changes and market fluctuations.

• The state has been implementing various poverty alleviation schemes to address this issue.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Poverty Line Definition:**

• The poverty line is the minimum level of income deemed adequate in a particular country.

• In India, it is defined based on the consumption expenditure and income required to meet basic needs.

• **Other States:**

• Bihar also has a high poverty rate, but it is slightly lower than Chhattisgarh's.

• Odisha and Madhya Pradesh are other states with high poverty percentages.

• **Poverty Alleviation Programs:**

• Programs like the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA) aim to provide employment and reduce rural poverty.

• Other initiatives include the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY) and National Rural Livelihood Mission (NRLM).

• **Economic Factors:**

• Economic growth, access to education, healthcare, and social security schemes are crucial in reducing poverty.

• Infrastructure development, such as roads and electricity, also plays a significant role in poverty reduction.
